item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky
item.stem: Meera watches the Sun from her balcony in Jaipur every morning. She notices that the Sun appears to rise in the east and set in the west each day. Why does the Sun appear to move from east to west across the sky?

options.A: The Sun revolves around Earth once every 24 hours
options.B: Earth rotates on its own axis from west to east
options.C: Earth revolves around the Sun once every year
options.D: The Moon pulls the Sun across the sky
